components.name: Stack
components.doc:
Stack(children: any[], opts?: {direction?: "col" | "row", gap?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch"}) — 纵向（默认）或横向排列子组件；横向在手机上换行
例：`root = Stack([summary, chart, note])`

components.name: Grid
components.doc:
Grid(children: any[], opts?: {columns?: number}) — 1–4 列网格，窄屏自动减少列数；适合并列的 Metric、EntityCard 或小图
例：`kpis = Grid([m1, m2, m3], {columns: 3})`

components.name: Card
components.doc:
Card(children: any[], opts?: {title?: string, subtitle?: string, badge?: string, tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info"}) — 有边界的一组内容；不要给每段内容都套 Card
例：`plan = Card([t1, m1], {title: "方案 A", badge: "推荐", tone: "success"})`

components.name: Tabs
components.doc:
Tabs(tabs: Tab[]) — 把并列的几组内容分页显示
例：`tabs = Tabs([Tab("图表", [chart]), Tab("明细", [table])])`

components.name: Tab
components.doc: Tab(label: string, children: any[]) — Tabs 中的一页

components.name: Details
components.doc:
Details(title: string, children: any[], opts?: {open?: boolean}) — 可折叠的一段次要内容（明细、方法、假设）；多个连用即手风琴
例：`more = Details("计算方法", [Text("按含税价计算")])`

components.name: Divider
components.doc: Divider(label?: string) — 分隔线，可带一个小标题

components.name: Heading
components.doc: Heading(text: string, opts?: {level?: number}) — 小节标题

components.name: Text
components.doc: Text(text: string, opts?: {tone?: "default" | "muted"}) — 一段纯文字

components.name: Callout
components.doc:
Callout(text: string, opts?: {tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info", title?: string}) — 需要注意的提示、风险或建议
例：`risk = Callout("价格为 10 月官网报价，可能调整", {tone: "warning", title: "注意"})`

components.name: Badge
components.doc: Badge(text: string, opts?: {tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info"}) — 简短状态标记

components.name: Quote
components.doc: Quote(text: string, opts?: {source?: string}) — 引用原文（论文、公告、条款中的原句）

components.name: List
components.doc:
List(items: string[], opts?: {ordered?: boolean, marker?: "dot" | "check" | "cross" | "arrow"}) — 要点列表；marker 为 check/cross 时表示满足或不满足
例：`needs = List(["支持 SSO", "本地部署"], {marker: "check"})`

components.name: KeyValue
components.doc:
KeyValue(items: {label: string, value: string | number | boolean | any, unit?: string}[], opts?: {columns?: number, decimals?: number}) — 一个对象的若干属性（规格、参数、档案）
例：`spec = KeyValue([{label: "上下文", value: 200000, unit: "token"}, {label: "发布", value: "2026-09"}])`

components.name: Code
components.doc:
Code(code: string, opts?: {language?: string, title?: string}) — 一段代码或命令，可复制
- 只有代码需要和其它组件放在一起（如 Tabs 分语言）时才用；单独的代码直接写在块外的 Markdown 代码围栏里。

components.name: Metric
components.doc:
Metric(label: string, value: number | string, opts?: {unit?: string, previous?: number, change?: number, better?: "high" | "low", decimals?: number, hint?: string, trend?: number[]}) — 一个关键数值；给出 previous 时组件自己算出并显示变化率
- 有上一期的数值就写 previous，不要自己算变化率；change 只用于资料直接给出的变化率（%），二者不同时写。
- better 为 low 时数值下降显示为好（成本、耗时、错误率）。trend 是近几期的数值，显示为迷你走势线。
例：`m = Metric("6 月销售额", 190, {unit: "万元", previous: 172, trend: [120, 135, 128, 160, 172, 190]})`

components.name: Progress
components.doc:
Progress(label: string, value: number, opts?: {max?: number, unit?: string, target?: number, tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info", decimals?: number}) — 完成度或配额用量；显示 value / max 和百分比
例：`p = Progress("已用存储", 38, {max: 50, unit: "GB"})`

components.name: Gauge
components.doc:
Gauge(label: string, value: number, opts?: {min?: number, max?: number, unit?: string, decimals?: number, better?: "high" | "low", target?: number}) — 单个数值在一个区间里的位置（得分、利用率、风险值）
例：`g = Gauge("CPU 利用率", 72, {max: 100, unit: "%", better: "low"})`

components.name: ShareBar
components.doc:
ShareBar(title: string, labels: string[], values: number[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 一个整体的组成，一条百分比条（组件算占比）；比饼图更省地方
例：`mix = ShareBar("流量来源", ["搜索", "直接", "社交"], [52, 30, 18])`

components.name: Highlights
components.doc:
Highlights(labels: string[], values: number[], facts: string[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, title?: string}) — 从一组数据算出的结论数字：最高、最低、合计、平均、首尾变化、最大增幅等
- 需要写“哪个最高/最低、合计多少、涨了多少、哪一期涨得最多”时用它，由组件计算并标出对应标签，不要在文字里自己算。
- facts：max 最高、min 最低、total 合计、avg 平均、median 中位数、range 极差、change 首尾变化（含变化率）、rise 最大单期增幅、drop 最大单期降幅、share 最大项占合计的比例。labels 有先后顺序时才用 change/rise/drop。
例：`facts = Highlights(months, sales, ["change", "rise", "max"], {unit: "万元"})`

components.name: LineChart
components.doc:
LineChart(title: string, categories: string[], series: Series[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, reference?: number, referenceLabel?: string, curve?: "linear" | "smooth" | "step", zero?: boolean, marks?: "max" | "min" | "last"[]}) — 随时间或顺序变化的趋势
- 纵轴默认按数据范围取值，zero 为 true 时从 0 开始。marks 在图上标出最高、最低或最后一个点的数值。reference 画一条参考线（目标、均值、阈值）。
例：`trend = LineChart("月销售额", months, [Series("销售额", sales)], {unit: "万元", marks: ["max", "last"]})`

components.name: AreaChart
components.doc:
AreaChart(title: string, categories: string[], series: Series[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, reference?: number, referenceLabel?: string, stacked?: boolean, percent?: boolean, curve?: "linear" | "smooth" | "step"}) — 趋势加总量；stacked 堆叠显示各部分随时间的构成，percent 显示为占比
例：`mix = AreaChart("各渠道用户", months, [Series("网页", web), Series("App", app)], {stacked: true})`

components.name: BarChart
components.doc:
BarChart(title: string, categories: string[], series: Series[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, reference?: number, referenceLabel?: string, horizontal?: boolean, stacked?: boolean, percent?: boolean, better?: "high" | "low"}) — 类别之间的数量对比；有负数时以 0 为中线向两侧分开
- 类别名长或超过 8 个时用 horizontal。stacked 堆叠各系列，percent 把每个类别换算成 100%。正负值（超预期/低于预期、盈亏）直接给带符号的数，better 决定正负哪边显示为好。排名用 Ranking。
例：`gap = BarChart("实际与预期之差", items.name, [Series("差值", items.gap)], {unit: "亿元", horizontal: true})`

components.name: ComboChart
components.doc:
ComboChart(title: string, categories: string[], bars: Series[], lines: Series[], opts?: {unit?: string, lineUnit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 柱和线放在同一张图：数量与比率（如收入和增长率）
- lineUnit 与 unit 不同时，线用右侧纵轴。
例：`rev = ComboChart("收入与增速", years, [Series("收入", revenue)], [Series("同比", growth)], {unit: "亿元", lineUnit: "%"})`

components.name: PieChart
components.doc:
PieChart(title: string, labels: string[], values: number[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 同一整体的少量组成部分（不超过 6 类），组件算占比
- 后两个参数是标签数组和数值数组，不放 Series。
例：`budget = PieChart("预算构成", items.name, items.amount, {unit: "万元"})`

components.name: Series
components.doc: Series(name: string, values: number[]) — 图表的一组数据，只作为图表参数使用

components.name: ScatterChart
components.doc:
ScatterChart(title: string, points: {name?: string, x: number, y: number, size?: number, group?: string}[], opts?: {xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, xUnit?: string, yUnit?: string, decimals?: number, trend?: boolean}) — 两个数值指标的关系（价格与得分、规模与效率）；size 字段画成气泡
- group 相同的点同色并进入图例。trend 为 true 时画最小二乘趋势线。
例：`fit = ScatterChart("价格与评分", @Each(models, "m", {name: m.name, x: m.price, y: m.score}), {xLabel: "价格", xUnit: "美元", yLabel: "评分"})`

components.name: RadarChart
components.doc:
RadarChart(title: string, axes: string[], series: Series[], opts?: {max?: number, decimals?: number}) — 几个对象在 3–8 个维度上的综合对比
例：`radar = RadarChart("能力对比", ["推理", "代码", "长文"], [Series("A", [9, 8, 7]), Series("B", [8, 9, 6])], {max: 10})`

components.name: Histogram
components.doc:
Histogram(title: string, values: number[], opts?: {bins?: number, unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 一组原始数值的分布；组件自己分箱
例：`dist = Histogram("响应时间分布", times, {unit: "ms"})`

components.name: BoxPlot
components.doc:
BoxPlot(title: string, groups: Series[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 几组原始数值的分布对比（中位数、四分位、离群值）；组件自己算统计量
例：`box = BoxPlot("各地区客单价", [Series("华东", east), Series("华北", north)], {unit: "元"})`

components.name: Heatmap
components.doc:
Heatmap(title: string, columns: string[], rows: string[], values: number[][], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, better?: "high" | "low"}) — 两个维度交叉的数值矩阵（时段×星期、地区×月份）
- values 每行对应 rows 的一项，每行的数与 columns 一一对应。
例：`heat = Heatmap("各时段订单", ["周一", "周二"], ["上午", "下午"], [[12, 18], [30, 25]])`

components.name: Waterfall
components.doc:
Waterfall(title: string, labels: string[], changes: number[], opts?: {start?: number, startLabel?: string, endLabel?: string, unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 从起点经过逐项增减到终点的拆解（利润桥、预算变化）；组件累计并算出终值
- changes 是带符号的增减量，不写累计值；start 是起点值，终值由组件算出。
例：`bridge = Waterfall("利润变化", ["销量", "价格", "成本"], [120, -40, -30], {start: 800, startLabel: "去年", endLabel: "今年", unit: "万元"})`

components.name: Funnel
components.doc:
Funnel(title: string, stages: string[], values: number[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 逐级转化（访问→注册→付费）；组件算每级转化率和总转化率
例：`f = Funnel("转化", ["访问", "注册", "付费"], [10000, 1800, 240], {unit: "人"})`

components.name: Treemap
components.doc:
Treemap(title: string, items: {name: string, value: number, group?: string}[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 很多部分组成一个整体，按面积比较大小（市值、预算科目）
例：`tm = Treemap("各业务收入", [{name: "云", value: 320, group: "企业"}, {name: "广告", value: 210}], {unit: "亿元"})`

components.name: Sankey
components.doc:
Sankey(title: string, links: {from: string, to: string, value: number}[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number}) — 数量从来源流向去处（预算分配、流量路径、能量流）
例：`s = Sankey("流量去向", [{from: "搜索", to: "注册", value: 300}, {from: "搜索", to: "离开", value: 700}])`

components.name: Candlestick
components.doc:
Candlestick(title: string, dates: string[], prices: number[][], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, rise?: "red" | "green"}) — 价格的开高低收（K 线）；默认红涨绿跌
- prices 每项是 [开, 高, 低, 收]。
例：`k = Candlestick("日 K", ["10-28", "10-29"], [[10.2, 10.8, 10.1, 10.6], [10.6, 10.7, 10.0, 10.1]], {unit: "元"})`

components.name: Dumbbell
components.doc:
Dumbbell(title: string, categories: string[], from: Series, to: Series, opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, better?: "high" | "low"}) — 每个类别的两个值及其差距：前后、预期与实际、去年与今年；组件算差值
例：`gap = Dumbbell("预期与实际", items.name, Series("预期", items.expected), Series("实际", items.actual), {unit: "亿元"})`

components.name: Timeline
components.doc:
Timeline(events: {date: string, title: string, text?: string, tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info"}[], opts?: {order?: "asc" | "desc"}) — 按时间排列的事件、里程碑或版本历史
例：`events = Timeline([{date: "2026-09", title: "发布", text: "首个公开版本"}, {date: "2026-10", title: "降价", tone: "success"}])`

components.name: Steps
components.doc:
Steps(steps: {title: string, text?: string, status?: "done" | "current" | "todo" | "error"}[], opts?: {current?: number, direction?: "vertical" | "horizontal"}) — 有先后顺序的步骤或流程状态；current 为当前步骤的序号（从 0 开始）
例：`how = Steps([{title: "申请", text: "提交材料"}, {title: "审核"}, {title: "放款"}], {current: 1})`

components.name: Checklist
components.doc:
Checklist(items: {text: string, done: boolean, note?: string}[], opts?: {title?: string}) — 逐项检查是否满足；组件统计完成数
例：`ready = Checklist([{text: "备份完成", done: true}, {text: "灰度验证", done: false}], {title: "上线检查"})`

components.name: Gantt
components.doc:
Gantt(title: string, tasks: {name: string, start: string, end: string, group?: string, done?: boolean}[]) — 任务的起止时间与重叠（项目排期、路线图）
- start/end 写成 YYYY-MM-DD；同一 group 的任务同色。
例：`plan = Gantt("排期", [{name: "设计", start: "2026-11-01", end: "2026-11-10"}, {name: "开发", start: "2026-11-08", end: "2026-12-05"}])`

components.name: Table
components.doc:
Table(columns: string[], rows: (string | number | any)[][], opts?: {decimals?: number}) — 逐项核对的表格；rows 为二维数组，最多 200 行，读者可点表头排序
- 每行的单元格数与列数相同、顺序一致，通常写成 @Each(items, "x", [x.name, x.amount])；合计不放进表格。
例：`detail = Table(["门店", "金额"], @Each(items, "x", [x.name, x.amount]), {decimals: 2})`

components.name: Compare
components.doc:
Compare(options: string[], rows: {label: string, values: (string | number | boolean | any)[], better?: "high" | "low", unit?: string}[], opts?: {decimals?: number, recommend?: string}) — 几个选项在多个属性上的对比矩阵；better 指出每行哪边好，组件标出每行最优
- values 与 options 一一对应；true/false 显示为支持/不支持。recommend 填推荐的选项名（必须在 options 中）。比较两三个产品、方案、型号时优先用它。
例：`cmp = Compare(["A", "B"], [{label: "价格", values: [20, 25], better: "low", unit: "美元/月"}, {label: "本地部署", values: [true, false]}], {recommend: "A"})`

components.name: Ranking
components.doc:
Ranking(title: string, items: {name: string, value: number, note?: string}[], opts?: {unit?: string, decimals?: number, better?: "high" | "low", top?: number}) — 按数值排名的列表；组件排序、编号并画出比例条
- items 不用事先排序；better 为 low 时数值小的排前面。top 只显示前几名。
例：`rank = Ranking("门店销售额", @Each(stores, "s", {name: s.name, value: s.amount}), {unit: "万元", top: 5})`

components.name: ProsCons
components.doc:
ProsCons(pros: string[], cons: string[], opts?: {title?: string, prosLabel?: string, consLabel?: string}) — 一个选择的优点与缺点
例：`pc = ProsCons(["便宜", "开源"], ["文档少"], {title: "方案 A"})`

components.name: EntityCard
components.doc:
EntityCard(name: string, opts?: {subtitle?: string, description?: string, fields?: {label: string, value: string | number | boolean | any, unit?: string}[], tags?: string[], badge?: string, rating?: number, price?: number, priceUnit?: string, highlight?: boolean, decimals?: number}) — 一个具体对象的名片：产品、公司、人物、地点、方案或套餐
- 几个 EntityCard 放进 Grid 做套餐或候选对比；highlight 为 true 的一张突出显示。rating 为 0–5 分。
例：`pro = EntityCard("专业版", {price: 99, priceUnit: "元/人/月", fields: [{label: "席位上限", value: 200}], tags: ["SSO"], highlight: true})`

components.name: Flow
components.doc:
Flow(nodes: {id: string, label: string, tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info"}[], edges: {from: string, to: string, label?: string}[], opts?: {direction?: "right" | "down", title?: string}) — 流程图或架构图：节点和有向连线，组件自动分层布局
- id 用英文，edges 的 from/to 写 id；最多约 30 个节点。有判断分支时在连线上写 label。
例：`arch = Flow([{id: "u", label: "用户"}, {id: "api", label: "API"}, {id: "db", label: "数据库"}], [{from: "u", to: "api"}, {from: "api", to: "db", label: "SQL"}])`

components.name: Tree
components.doc:
Tree(root: {name: string, note?: string, children?: any[]}, opts?: {title?: string, depth?: number}) — 层级结构：组织架构、分类体系、知识脉络、思维导图
- 每个节点是 {name, note?, children?}，children 是同样结构的数组；depth 为默认展开的层数。
例：`org = Tree({name: "公司", children: [{name: "研发", children: [{name: "前端"}, {name: "后端"}]}, {name: "销售"}]})`

components.name: Diff
components.doc:
Diff(before: string, after: string, opts?: {language?: string, title?: string}) — 修改前后的文本或代码，组件按行标出增删
例：`d = Diff("timeout = 30", "timeout = 60", {language: "python"})`

components.name: FileTree
components.doc:
FileTree(paths: string[], opts?: {title?: string}) — 目录结构；路径用 / 分隔，目录以 / 结尾
例：`files = FileTree(["src/", "src/app.ts", "src/lib/db.ts", "README.md"])`

components.name: JsonView
components.doc:
JsonView(data: any, opts?: {title?: string, depth?: number}) — 可折叠的 JSON 数据（接口返回、配置）
例：`resp = JsonView({id: 7, tags: ["a", "b"], owner: {name: "lin"}}, {title: "返回值"})`

components.name: Select
components.doc: Select(label: string, options: string[], value?: $binding<string | string[]>, opts?: {multiple?: boolean}) — 从几个选项中选一个（multiple 为 true 时可多选，值为数组）；选项少而短时显示为分段按钮

components.name: Slider
components.doc: Slider(label: string, min: number, max: number, value?: $binding<number>, opts?: {step?: number, unit?: string}) — 在范围内调一个数值，例如预算、数量、比例

components.name: Toggle
components.doc: Toggle(label: string, value?: $binding<boolean>) — 开或关的一个选项

components.name: Input
components.doc: Input(label: string, value?: $binding<string | number>, opts?: {placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "number" | "date"}) — 让用户填一小段文字或数字，通常再由 Button 把它发出去

components.name: Button
components.doc: Button(label: string, action?: @ToAssistant, opts?: {tone?: "default" | "primary"}) — 帮助用户进行下一步的按钮，点击后以用户身份发送 @ToAssistant 中的文字

components.name: HtmlArtifact
components.doc:
HtmlArtifact(title: string, document: string, fallbackText: string) — 一个完整的 HTML 页面（含 CSS、JavaScript），在隔离的框架中运行；fallbackText 是页面要点的纯文字版
- 只用于组件无法表达的内容：交互模拟、动画演示、自定义图示、小工具或小游戏；静态的数值对照、时间轴、流程和对比都有组件。
- 写在 openui 围栏里：`root = Stack([page])`，再写 `page = HtmlArtifact("标题", '<!doctype html>…完整页面…', "页面要点的纯文字版")`；不用 html 代码围栏输出。
- document 用单引号字符串，内容按页面源码原样写，可以直接换行，JavaScript 里的反斜杠（如 \"、\n）照常只写一个；页面里的 HTML 属性和 JavaScript 字符串用双引号，单引号要写成 \'。
- 页面在隔离的框架里运行，无法联网：不引用外部脚本、样式、字体或图片，不用 fetch、localStorage、alert 和表单提交；图形用内联 SVG 或 canvas。
- document 不超过 24000 个字符；fallbackText 不超过 2000 个字符，写清页面展示的结论和关键数据，供复制、搜索和打印使用。
- 配色用宿主变量 var(--fg)、var(--muted)、var(--bg)、var(--surface)、var(--border)、var(--accent) 和 var(--series-1) 到 var(--series-6)，背景保持透明，深色浅色自动一致；宽度自适应（手机约 320px），高度随内容，不用 100vh 或固定高度。
- 页面不能替用户发消息；需要用户下一步时，在 HtmlArtifact 之外放 Button。
